definition: Decorated prominently with a striking design or emblem.
author: Charles Dickens
quote: Bucket, in the foremost emblazoned carriage, uses his two fat forefingers to hold the lattice a hair’s breadth open while he looks.
example_sentence: Her jacket was emblazoned with the club crest.
